scientific_integrity: Analytic proof and standalone finite checks; no simulations used as proofs. Potential equivalent earlier formulations and priority have not been independently ruled out.
scientific_limitations: Two independent symmetric uniforms, fixed sum of squared coefficients, and nonnegative strikes. No more-summand assertion; broad cube-slab priority risk because the 2003 and 2011 original articles were not inspected in complete full text.
title: Sharp stop-loss envelopes for two variance-normalized uniform summands
